title: NVIDIA Onyx Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NVIDIA Onyx switches. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the /admin/launch endpoint. When parsing the script query parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
